message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate entries were consolidated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-12 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-13 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-12 13:10 IST through 2026-10-13 13:10 IST**).

No credible vulnerability newly reported or authoritatively updated during this 24-hour window could be matched to a component and version in the DLL inventory.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found.

Fresh CVE records identified during the search affected unrelated products and were excluded after product matching. NuGet and npm advisory checks, targeted vendor/component searches, and CISA checks likewise produced no in-scope, fresh match.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations.

No MongoDB-family vulnerability could be verified as newly reported or authoritatively updated within the scan window. The most recent entries visible in MongoDB's security alerts predated the window, and targeted CVE/NVD, GitHub Security Advisory, and CISA searches did not surface a fresher credible record.

### Sources checked

- [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [GitHub Advisory Database — NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anuget)
- [GitHub Advisory Database — npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anpm)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not reassess older vulnerabilities already known to affect the listed legacy component versions.
